description.en: Gyeono Kang, a lucky high schooler, used to enjoy the mutual love he shared with the prettiest girl in his class, Chanbi Baek. She was always all about him until an accident wiped her memories of the past year, and just like that, she no longer had feelings for him. But what about Gyeono, whose heart still beats for her? Is it even possible to win her back? Did she really like him back to begin with?! Somebody help!

Mumyeong Heo’s grandmother passed away years ago. But when he visits her home to spend some time in the quiet countryside, he notices that someone kept it clean all this time.
His new neighbors aren’t exactly thrilled by his visit. In fact, most of them don’t want him around.
But that’s when his nasty neighbors go missing one by one… for better or worse.

description.en: It was a peaceful life for humanity. Protected by the order of valiant knights they could be sure the randomly appearing gates to other worlds will be closed, and if any monsters slip through, they will be immediately caught. But on that day everything went wrong. The portal gates wouldn’t seal up. The guest from another world wouldn’t obey. The young knight was suspected to be self-proclaimed, which led to his imprisonment in a monster detention prison. His seemingly imminent death led to a new beginning. That day is carved into humanity history as future-changing. The day when the portal gates were forced open.

Many years ago, there lived a knight who loved a saint. However, wanting to not hurt the saint who wasn't allowed to have personal feelings, he made sure to keep a safe distance from her. Eventually, the saint died in his arms and the devastated knight swore, with bitter anguish, 'If you get a chance at another life, I'll make sure that you will no longer live as a saint.' After long 300 years, the saint was reborn. Will their wishes finally come true in this life?

description.en:
I Woke Up as the Leader of Prison?!
I got transmigrated into a book, but—excuse me, what?!
What am I supposed to do when I transmigrate ten years before the original story even starts?

The setting: prison.
The problem: it's worse than the jungle. A lawless war zone.

After rolling through hell for ten years, I became…

The leader of the prison.

"Hey, Mint. You might wanna chill."
"I’m afraid I don’t know what you’re talking about, sir."

I ended up a swaggering prison gang leader.
But hey, I’m fine with this.
This is what we call the privilege of a long-time survivor.

"On paper, you’ll be considered dead. In return, you’ll do a job for me."
"I’m afraid I still don’t understand, sir."

Then a chance came—like a lie made real.

"Help me, and I’ll get you released."
"What do you need, Master?"
"..."

The prison chief gave an order to me—now known as the prison’s #1 certified nutcase:

"Turn the new guy into the boss of this prison."

They call it prison, but this place is a total free-for-all.
And if I manage to crown one man as the next boss, I finally get out.

"But the place you're going to… is the men’s prison."
"...Huh? I don’t exactly have the thing for that?"
"Disguise. Got it? Disguise!"

…Except—oops?
Turns out that new recruit? He’s the original male lead.

description.en:
It all begins in the forest village of Adat, where the tomboy Iremi sees the infamous mage Edermask en route to her hometown. Wanting to find out who is stronger, she sets off to challenge him with her childhood friend Enzu, a novice swordsman who is always being dragged around wherever she goes.  
  
Iremi and Enzu then start a journey along with Edermask, each seeking something different from their journey: Enzu seeks revenge for the murder of his father, Edermask is looking for a lost magic, and Iremi is just there for the ride. Without knowing the dangers their journey might bring them, they set sail to fulfill their heart’s desires and uncloak the mystery behind Edermask's immortality.

Следом за девушкой увязался ее закадычный друг Энжи, начинающий фехтовальщик, который всегда цепляется к ней, как банный лист... description.en:
I was a runaway orphan working three jobs to survive. I was always exhausted, but at least I had money. One day, I overheard some girls talking about *Crown Princess Heine*, a novel known for its risqué scenes. But before I could read it, I died! Soon, I transmigrated into the book as the villainess, Annette Ethelred. Annette is hated by everyone because she tried to kill Heine, but I'm not going down that route. I'm going to keep my head down, make money, and check out all the hot guys!
___
She grew up an orphan, working herself to death in part-time jobs, and eventually died from exhaustion. 

Right before her death, she was reading an R-rated romance fantasy novel and found herself reincarnated as Annette Ethelred, the twisted villainess who was adopted into a duke's family and was bent on killing the novel's heroine. Annette was also the last princess of a fallen kingdom. Her happiness over the lavish lifestyle of the duke’s family didn’t last long, as she was quickly thrown out with nothing to her name, punished for the evil deeds of the original Annette. 

But giving up wasn’t an option. With the survival skills honed from all her part-time jobs, she managed to get hired as a maid at the temple. 

"This time around, I’ll make lots of money and date a handsome man! ...But seriously, are there no normal guys around here?!"

Dia juga seorang penjahat dengan kepribadian rusak yang berusaha membunuh pahlawan wanita. Pikiran untuk menjalani kehidupan kaya sebagai keluarga duke hanyalah kebahagiaan sesaat. Karena dosa asal dari perbuatan jahat Annette, aku diusir tanpa satu sen pun! ....... Masih terlalu dini untuk menyerah. Dengan keterampilan bertahan hidup yang kukembangkan melalui kerja paruh waktu, aku mendapat pekerjaan sebagai pelayan di sebuah kuil. description.en:
I had my share of working overtime for an evil employer. It's no surprise that I died from it! But as if being reborn as Irene Werber, a minor character in a romance novel, wasn't shocking enough, it turns out that my kind older brother is destined to work for the world's most evil superior, Crown Prince Ervin Manuel Terence! It's up to me to stop my brother from being exploited! The only problem is... I don't even know what this prince looks like!

---
“Your Highness! The papers have piled up like this…!”

I reincarnated as Irene Weber, the younger sister of an aide who is suffering from overtime because of the prince who is in love and neglects his work. Irene, who was buried in work before the reincarnation and died of overwork, intends to protect her beloved brother from such a terrible thing.

No overtime! No call after work! Evil boss, go away! Work less and earn more, Brother!

To the end, Irene tries to separate the prince from her brother. A method to win by knowing your enemy and knowing yourself. Irene scraps a little record without leaving any details, of the Prince whose face she doesn’t even know about, for the future. Somehow, her brother’s face, looking at such Irene, is dark…

“Brother, if you’re meeting the Crown Prince today, I’ll go with–”

“Absolutely not.”

'Do you want to meet him alone so much?’

–

“Before that, Benjamin Weber, when can I meet your sister?” 

“Not for the rest of your life.”

The most affectionate brother and sister of the continent. Will the day come when these two siblings can resolve their growing misunderstanding?
description.fr: En me réincarnant en Irène Weber je me suis rendue compte du triste destin qu'attendait le frère de celle-ci, il est écrit qu'il mourra d'un surplus de travail, en effet en plus de son propre travail il fait également celui du prince. Je suis Irène désormais et je fais la promesse que mon frère se reposera, même si je dois travailler à sa place! Pourtant le fait que je vois le prince seul à seul n'a pas l'air de lui plaire, en effet il refuse que sa petite sœur chérie soit proche d'un autre homme!
description.id: Aku adalah karyawan di perusahaan jahat yang selalu membuat karyawannya lembur. Suatu hari, saat sedang lembur tiba-tiba aku merasuk menjadi Irene Weber. Irene bukan tokoh dalam novel, sehingga aku bebas melakukan apa saja. Tapi, yang menjadi masalah adalah kakakku, Benjamin Weber, akan menjadi asisten putra mahkota, perusahaan jahat dalam novel ini. Aku tidak boleh membiarkan kakakku diperbudak oleh putra mahkota yang sibuk berkencan. Aku akan menyelamatkan kakakku dari perusahaan jahat!
description.ru: Будучи эксплуатируемой компанией, в которой работала, я потеряла сознание в груде документов… «Ваше Высочество! Скопилось столько работы!..» Я переродилась младшей сестрой так напоминающего меня в прошлой жизни секретаря, страдающего от массы тяжелой работы по вине наследного принца?! Используя «добросердечный и наивный характер» старшего брата, он собирался скинуть на него всю свою работу… Однако вспоминая прежнюю себя, я не могу так просто это оставить!!! Так начался мой план по разделению этих двух юношей… «Хм, прошло много времени, так что ты тоже с нами…» Почему же кажется, что этот эксплуататор проявляет ко мне интерес?! Что в прошлой, что в нынешней жизни внутри книги, почему угнетатели так меня любят? К тому же… «Тронете мою сестренку, и вам всем конец.» Теперь еще и такой добрый и наивный старший братик, чересчур опекающий свою младшую сестру?..
description.uk:
Експлуатація праці злочинною корпорацією, завали документів, перевтома на роботі… і от я знепритомніла.

"Ваше Високість! Ці гори документів…!" Я перенеслася в тіло молодшої сестри помічника, який страждає від перевантаження через кронпринца, що разюче нагадує мене в моєму попередньому житті! Цей "хороший і лагідний" брат дозволяє собою маніпулювати. Думка про моє минуле не дає мені стояти осторонь!Так розпочалася моя операція розлучення цих двох чоловіків… "Ну, оскільки ми всі тут, приєднуйся до нас…" Але чомусь ця жива "злочинна корпорація" починає відчувати до мене симпатію?! Чому ж, і в сучасному світі, і в книзі, такі корпорації так мене люблять? А ще… "Якщо хтось зачепить мою сестру, я зітру їх із лиця землі." 

Чи не занадто добрий і лагідний брат, який виявився типовим "сіс-ком"?
description.zh: 皇太子每天花天酒地，不务正业！所有业务都让行政官来替他执行， 在累死社畜行政官的奇葩社畜剧情之下，我穿越成他的妹妹…但是！哥哥也太温柔善良了吧？把我捧在手心上宠！ 让前世凄惨的我，完全不忍心他受累被欺负。 这辈子我要守护哥哥，不让他成为皇太子的工具人！
description.pt-br: "Sua Alteza! Os papéis se acumularam assim ...! ” Eu reencarnei como Irene Weber, a irmã mais nova de um ajudante que está sofrendo horas extras por causa do príncipe que está apaixonado e negligencia seu trabalho. Irene, que estava enterrada no trabalho antes da reencarnação e morreu de excesso de trabalho, pretende proteger seu amado irmão de uma coisa tão terrível. Sem horas extras! Nenhuma chamada depois do trabalho! Chefe do mal, vá embora! Trabalhe menos e ganhe mais, irmão! Ao final, Irene tenta separar o príncipe de seu irmão. Um método para vencer conhecendo seu inimigo e conhecendo a si mesmo. Irene raspa um pequeno registro sem deixar nenhum detalhe, do príncipe cujo rosto ela nem conhece, para o futuro. De alguma forma, o rosto de seu irmão, olhando para tal Irene, está sombrio ... "Irmão, se você vai encontrar o Príncipe Herdeiro hoje, eu irei com ..." "Absolutamente não." ‘Você quer tanto conhecê-lo sozinho?’ *** “Antes disso, Benjamin Weber, quando posso conhecer sua irmã?” "Não para o resto da sua vida." O irmão e a irmã mais afetuosos do continente. Chegará o dia em que esses dois irmãos poderão resolver seu crescente mal-entendido?

description.en:
For the sake of survival, I kissed the protagonist and we became partners. But I just can't believe that the 'kind' protagonist in the original novel was all an act!

"If I kill you, this partnership will be broken."

"You can't do that. We'll both die at the same time."

We were tied together by a tightly shared fate. Sharing the same wounds, the same pain, the same life and death. Plus, we had to have physical contact for the symbiosis?

When I found out about his mask, he was cruel to me with no hesitation. Unreasonable amounts of work, unreasonable demands… Why can't I be with another man?

"I've figured it out! How to break this partnership!"

Now that my life would be safe, all that's left is to get away―

"I have no intention of breaking it."

"…Pardon?"

"Just like you, I'm also curious," he held me in his arms and his gaze slowly descended to my lips, "I'm curious about to what extent our pain will be shared."

---

description.en:
The Crown Prince was cursed to swap bodies with the women he slept with, and I became the daughter of the Duke’s family who was punished for not being able to lift his curse. In order to break it, I seduced the cold and indifferent prince to spend the night with him. While I was in his body, I consumed a magic potion that would dispel the curse but soon forgot about him… Unfortunately, it didn’t lift the curse but made it worse instead. Soon, we started changing bodies unconsciously?! Now, the only solution I see is for us to desire for each other so we can return to our own bodies.
___
In the spicy novel *The Cursed Crown Prince*, Prince Frederick is struck with a curse that causes him to switch bodies with any woman he spends the night with. This brings misfortune to the Chandler family, who is unfairly executed for treason when the royal physician, Cedric Chandler, fails to cure the prince. So the heroine knows she's in trouble when she wakes up as Irenia, the daughter of the Chandler family. Luckily, she also knows about the magic potion that can lift the curse, and seduces the cold Frederick to switch bodies with him. Once she feeds him the potion and gets her body back, "Irenia" thinks her problems are solved for good. But not long after she bids the prince goodbye, the two start switching bodies again at random times! And the only way for them to switch back is to spend the night with each other...

Vị vua hiện tại đã giết vị vua trước đó. Cô ấy đã ở bên Thái tử vì những giọt nước mắt kỳ diệu của anh ấy.
Chứng kiến ​​cảnh tượng và lời nói hấp hối của mẹ - Thái tử mất khả năng khóc.

Cha mẹ Rivera mất khi cô còn nhỏ, cô bị đuổi ra khỏi nhà. Cô ấy cuối cùng được nhận nuôi bởi một đại quý tộc.

Nhị Hoàng tử đã giúp Rivera ra khỏi ngục. Nhị Hoàng tử nói với Rivera cách duy nhất để phá vỡ hôn ước là Rivera đưa nước mắt của Thái tử cho đức vua hiện tại. description.en:
Kit never forgot her first love, Edwin. One day, she realized that Edwin had been sending some kind of signal for help. So she turned back time to the day when he was still alive. Edwin had given up on his life and only waited for his death to come. But when Kit pleaded for his life, his frozen heart thawed a little.

“Let’s move forward, but this time we will escape death,” she said, “You are not alone. We will do this together.”

Their affections for each other grew more as they battled against death. However, there was a dark energy of an inevitable doom that hovered between them….

“Your presence. You being alive is all that matters to me,” she said.

The moment they meet each other over time, their love becomes a stronger reality.

---
Neglected by her family, Kitt develops a silent affection for Edwin, a man she encounters in a library, yet she never reveals her feelings before he tragically dies. Haunted by this loss, Kitt miraculously awakens in a time prior to the fatal event. As she attempts to save Edwin, she finds out he has lost his will to live a long time ago, caught in a cycle of death and time reversals. Undeterred by Edwin's cold demeanor, Kitt persists in her efforts. Could she hold the key to his salvation?

description.en:
I lived my whole life being used by other people and died at the age of sixteen. I thought it would be over like that, but when I opened my eyes again, I was back in the past. I thought I'd die while living the rest of my life in pain one more time. 

But suddenly, a father who I had never seen before appeared before me. My dad, whom I hadn't even known existed.

===

"When are you going to take away my powers?"

Dante's eyes shook greatly at Ivanna's words.

"Everyone did. You, when will you take it?"

"…I won't."

"Why?"

Ivanna couldn't understand. Everyone coveted her power. Everyone wanted it, saying she was a sacrifice sent by God for humans. So why does he refuse?

"No one will take your power now. No one will bother you. I'll protect you."

"You're trying to take my power."

"I'm not."

"Everyone said that and stole my power from me. They locked me up in prison."

It was too cruel for a mere five-year-old to say. But the young Ivanna's face had no emotion as if what she said were natural. Dante's heart eventually collapsed when he saw his daughter completely shattered.

---
Abducted from her mother at a young age and tortured for her incredible power, Evanna knew nothing but agony her whole life. That is until one day, she is rescued and returned to the father she never knew, the Duke of Vicente. But as Evanna’s very existence brings back painful memories for the Duke, he must learn how to love her, while Evanna must come to trust her father and heal her trauma. But with Evanna's power highly coveted, can these two overcome their thorny pasts for a rosier future?

J'ai vécu toute ma vie en étant utilisé par d'autres personnes et je suis morte à l'âge de 16 ans. Je pensais que ce serait fini comme ça, mais quand j'ai rouvert les yeux, j'étais de retour dans le passé. Je pensais que j'allais mourir en vivant encore une fois le reste de ma vie dans la douleur.

Mais soudain, un père que je n'avais jamais vu auparavant est apparu devant moi. Mon père, dont je ne connaissais même pas l'existence.

«Quand vas-tu m'enlever mes pouvoirs?»

Les yeux de Dante tremblèrent énormément aux paroles d'Ivanna.

«Tout le monde l'a fait. Toi, quand vas-tu le prendre?»

«…Je ne le ferai pas.»

«Pourquoi?»

Ivanna ne comprenait pas. Tout le monde convoitait son pouvoir. Tout le monde le voulait, disant qu'elle était un sacrifice envoyé par Dieu pour les humains. Alors pourquoi refuse-t-il?

«Personne ne prendra votre pouvoir maintenant. Personne ne vous dérangera. Je te protégerai.»

« Vous essayez de prendre mon pouvoir.»

«Ce n'est pas le cas.»

«Tout le monde a dit ça et m'a volé mon pouvoir. Ils m'ont enfermé en prison.»

C'était trop cruel pour un simple enfant de cinq ans à dire. Mais le visage de la jeune Ivanna n'avait aucune émotion comme si ce qu'elle disait était naturel.

Le cœur de Dante s'est finalement effondré lorsqu'il a vu sa fille complètement brisée.

Saya menjalani seluruh hidup saya digunakan oleh orang lain dan meninggal pada usia 16 tahun. Saya pikir itu akan berakhir seperti itu, tetapi ketika saya membuka mata lagi, saya kembali ke masa lalu. Saya pikir saya akan mati sambil menjalani sisa hidup saya dalam kesakitan sekali lagi. Tapi tiba-tiba, seorang ayah yang belum pernah saya lihat sebelumnya muncul di hadapan saya. Ayah saya, yang saya bahkan tidak tahu ada. "Kapan kamu akan mengambil kekuatanku?" Mata Dante bergetar hebat mendengar kata-kata Ivanna. “Semua orang melakukannya. Kamu, kapan kamu akan mengambilnya? ” “…Aku tidak akan.” "Mengapa?" Ivanna tidak mengerti. Semua orang mendambakan kekuatannya. Semua orang menginginkannya, mengatakan dia adalah pengorbanan yang dikirim oleh Tuhan untuk manusia. Lalu kenapa dia menolak? “Tidak ada yang akan mengambil kekuatanmu sekarang. Tidak ada yang akan mengganggu Anda. Aku akan melindungimu." "Kamu mencoba mengambil kekuatanku." "Aku tidak." “Semua orang mengatakan itu dan mencuri kekuatanku dariku. Mereka mengurung saya di penjara.” Itu terlalu kejam untuk dikatakan oleh anak berusia lima tahun. Tapi wajah Ivanna muda tidak menunjukkan emosi seolah-olah apa yang dia katakan adalah wajar. Hati Dante akhirnya runtuh ketika melihat putrinya benar-benar hancur.

description.ko:
평생 힘을 뽑히며 살다가 결국 열여섯 살에 죽었다.

그렇게 모든 것이 끝난 줄 알았는데.
눈을 뜨니 과거로 돌아와 있었다.

다시 시작된 제물로서의 삶.
이번에도 평생 고통만 느끼다가 죽을 줄 알았는데.

갑자기 내 앞에 한 번도 본 적 없던 아빠가 나타났다.

나처럼 내 존재를 전혀 몰랐던 아빠가.

–

“내 힘은 언제 가져갈 거야?”

이반나의 말에 단테의 두 눈이 크게 흔들렸다.

“다들 그랬어. 당신은 언제 가져가?”
“……나는, 가져가지 않을 거다.”
“왜?”

이반나는 이해할 수 없었다. 모두가 제힘을 탐냈다.
인간을 위해 신께서 보내 주신 제물이라며 모두가 가지고 싶어 했다.
그런데 왜 이 사람은 거부하는 걸까?

“이제는 누구도 네 힘을 빼앗아 가지 못할 거다. 누구도 너를 괴롭히지 못할 거다. 내가 너를 지켜 주겠다.”
“내 힘을 가져가겠다는 거네.”
“그러지 않는다고…….”
“다들 그렇게 말하면서 내 힘을 뽑아 갔어. 날 감옥에 가둬 두고.”

고작 다섯 살의 아이가 한 말이라기엔 너무 잔혹했다. 하지만 어린 이반나의 얼굴은 아무런 감정도 깃들어 있지 않았다. 그게 당연하다는 듯.

완전히 망가져 버린 딸의 모습에 결국 단테는 완전히 무너져 내렸다.

С самого рождения я жила, имея огромную силу, но погибла в возрасте 16 лет. Мне казалось, что все закончилось, однако, открыв глаза, я поняла, что вернулась в детство. Жизнь началась с чистого листа. Когда и ты так поступишь?» «Я не буду забирать у тебя ее.» «Почему?» Эванна не могла ничего понять, ведь каждый жаждал обладать силой. Все люди мечтали отобрать силу, говоря, что она жертва, посланная Богами. Однако, почему этот человек не такой? «Больше никто не отнимет твою силу и не потревожит тебя. description.de: Soojin wacht eines Tages im Körper der 18-jährigen Lea auf, einer Figur aus ihrem Lieblings-Webroman. Als wiedergeborene Schurkin muss sie nun versuchen, ihre eigene Hinrichtung zu verhindern und den ursprünglichen Storyverlauf zu ändern. Dies gelingt ihr allerdings nur, wenn sie ihre Verlobung mit dem attraktiven aber unterkühlten Herzog Darius Karlsson auflöst. Doch Darius denkt gar nicht daran, seine Verlobte gehen zu lassen... Kann Lea ihrem Schicksal noch entkommen? Und welche Absichten verfolgt der charmante Herzog Vernon, der offenbar ein Auge auf sie geworfen hat?
description.en:
Now, to my fiancé and soon-to-be stranger, I have declared war.
"I'll end this engagement."

Soojin, who got abandoned by her boyfriend of 8 years... One day, she possessed the body of "Leah Prezis," the villainess from the web novel she enjoyed reading.

Knowing about her future pointless death, she made a request to her fiancé Devan to survive...

"I'll end this engagement."

She thought the break-up would go smoothly, but it collapsed all at once after he said, "Why should I?"

Will Soojin be able to escape death in vain and return to her modern life safely?

---
Soojin is suddenly transported into the 18-year-old body of Leah, the second female lead in her favorite web novel. As a villainess reincarnate, her mission is to avoid a tragic end. Soojin's only option is to break off the engagement with Devan, her egotistical fiancé... However, he is not making this easy, not one bit.
description.fr: Soojin est une femme ordinaire qui essaye de noyer son chagrin d'amour dans la lecture de romans en ligne. Un jour, à son réveil, elle se retrouve subitement dans la peau du personnage de la méchante, Léa Francis. Soojin connaît son destin: elle mourra exécutée si elle ne change pas le sort du personnage qu'elle incarne à présent. Comment? En commençant par rompre ses fiançailles! Mais son fiancé, David Carsons, bien qu'il ne semble rien éprouver pour elle, la traitant même avec dédain, n'est pourtant pas prêt à la laisser partir.
description.id: Oh Soojin tiba-tiba masuk ke dalam tubuh karakter favorit nya yang merupakan seorang Villainnes berumur 18 tahun bernama Leah Francis di novel yang ia baca. Namun, karena akhir dari Villainnes ini adalah kematian, Soojin berusaha untuk menghindari akhir yang tragis itu dengan melakukan pembatalan pertunangan dengan Devan Carsons, lelaki pemeran utama kedua di novel, yang sangat Leah cintai. Namun, tanpa disangka-sangka, Devan tidak menyetujui pembatalan pertunangan itu! Bagaimana ini?!
description.ja:

「婚約を破棄して差し上げます。」

곧 남이 될 그에게 선전 포고를 했다.

약혼자인 데이반에게 한 가지 부탁을 하는데..

"이제 그만 파혼해 드릴게요."

description.zh-hk:
剛剛，我向馬上就會成為外人的未婚夫宣戰了。 “我們解除婚約吧。”

被交往八年的男朋友拋棄了的秀珍 有一天…穿越到了她喜歡的網絡小說的惡毒女配“蕾雅·普雷吉斯”身上。

她清楚自己會白白送死的結局 所以為了活下來 她拜託了未婚夫戴凡一件事… “我們解除婚約吧。”

本以為婚約會順利解除的， 卻得到了“我憑什麼？”的答覆，計劃泡湯了。

面對死亡的結局，秀珍真的可以平安無事地回到現實生活裡嗎？

Anriette may look like an average noble, but she's actually a human who's been transported into the world of her favorite novel, cursed by its author for writing fanfics critical of the original ending. And as Anriette, her fate is to be slain by the very male lead she wrote her fanfics about! Can she use her inside knowledge to craft the ending she always dreamed of for her favorite lead?

---
She possessed the body of Anri Wentworth, the daughter of a family that was unjustly executed by the Male Lead. Duke Edwin Askar, the queen’s faithful dog… No, the decadent man who would become her lover and a sycophant.

Just avoid the male lead and evade death!

Then one day. The mare of the carriage she’s riding makes eye contact with the stallion of the carriage the male lead is riding…?

The accidental carriage accident brings her face to face with Edwin.

“How about we get married instead.”

With determination dripping from his indifferent eyes, Edwin proposes a contract marriage to Anri…

‘By the way, what about the queen?’

과연 그 공작이 "아내 집착" 하게 되는 사연은?

이곳은 직접 19금 팬픽까지 쓸 만큼 사랑했던 작품 속 세계.
남주도 여주도 위험한 인물들이니, 조용히 숨어나 살 생각이었는데

description.ja: お金なら何でもする貧民街の有名人、マディ。彼女の目に入ってきたのはユリキアンだった。皇位を狙っているおじの計略により、隠れ生活のユリキアン。復讐はしたいが、何もできない自分の立場がつらい。「マディ、俺と結婚しよう。」「は?金さえあればなんでもすると思うなよ! 人の人生は金で買えないんだから!」「1億。」「今なんて…?」「10億。」「あなたぁ～!今までどこにいたの?ずっと探してましたよ～?」復讐のための出会い、運命を変えた恋へつながる。
description.ko:
권력다툼으로 가족을 잃은 채 황제에게 목숨을 위협받고 있는 '율리키안' 대공은 어떻게든 황제의 관심에서 멀어지고자 일부러 망나니짓을 하며 살고 있다. 
그러던 중, 빈민촌에서 만난 사기꾼 '매디'라는 여성과 계약 결혼을 통해 자신의 평판을 더욱 깎기로 다짐한다. 
그런데 이 매디라는 여성, 과거가 심상치 않은 것 같다. 
그렇게 아슬아슬하게 계약 결혼에 골인하기 위한 고군분투 계약 연애를 통해 서로를 알게 될수록 점점 끌리기 시작하는데….
description.ru:
Великий герцог Юлликиан потерял родителей в результате борьбы за трон. В отчаянных попытках избежать внимания нынешнего императора, желающего избавиться от потенциального соперника за власть, он начинает вести разгульный образ жизни.

Случайным образом столкнувшись с Мэдди, мошенницей из трущоб, Юлликиан решает заключить с ней фиктивный брак, чтобы ещё сильнее подорвать свою репутацию.

Однако, изображая на людях бурный роман, они постепенно сближаются и начинают испытывать друг к другу всё более глубокие чувства...
description.pt-br:
Yulikian perdeu os pais para os planos do tio de tomar o trono.

Seguindo o último desejo da mãe, que queria sobreviver, ele frequenta as favelas diariamente para evitar o olhar do tio.

Mas é atormentado pela incapacidade de agir, apesar do crescente desejo de vingança.

É então que "Maddie Louca", uma figura famosa nas favelas, o aborda com uma atitude astuta.

Embora Yulikian inicialmente não queira nada com ela,

tem uma ideia brilhante depois de vê-la eliminar dois assassinos em um beco e desaparecer instantaneamente.

Yulikian agarra o pulso dela.

"Eu já disse que não vim te procurar para serviços de guarda-costas."

"Então o quê, quer namorar?"

"Não. Casamento."

"...O quê?"

"Case comigo."

"Você acha que dinheiro compra tudo! Como ousa tentar comprar a vida de alguém!"

"100 milhões."

"...Desculpe, pode repetir?"

"1 bilhão."

“Querida, onde você esteve todo esse tempo? Eu te encontrei.”

description.en:
Hani, the working woman with no interest in dating and who brags about her best trait of not being in debt has an accident with her best friend’s younger brother! The development of a youthful romance in an era where chivalry and courtship is dead. The story of Hani’s turbulent romance.
___
One night, Hani goes out to drink with her best friend's brother and wakes up... in bed with him? What happens when she becomes pregnant from her one night stand? Watch Hani's trials and tribulations as she tries to hide the truth about the real father.

description.en:
A heartbreaking, fantasy romance of the two wounded souls finding their way back to each other again.   
"He abandoned me as a child, and I lost my voice. When I was reunited with him I was already broken."   
  
Little Bella, a war orphan who once trusted for survival; grows up carrying an abandonment wound. It’s a life without purpose, she’s the unseen, unheard, and a war slave.  
Kiris embraces Bella, a girl he once abandoned, now has been forgotten. Maybe it is too late when he’d found her again.   
   
Will she get over past hurts and believe in love again, when there is too much damage done?
